title: 第1章 这蘑菇怎么会动？
slug: 在须弥假装是一个学者
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

鼻尖传来一丝带有青草的味道，王言感觉自己恢复了一点触觉，身子底下也传来草叶刺挠的感觉。

下意识的睁开眼睛，眼皮子有点重，同时浑身无力。

‘我怎么了？’

渐渐地，脑海中思绪开始重新活跃。

很快，王言便想起了昏迷前最后的画面。

“对了，我在一边做日常，一边在一个DND的帖子下和人讨论有哪些法术，设定里很厉害，但游戏里不怎么出彩的…”

大脑渐渐清晰，王言身上的力气似乎也恢复了一些，吃力地环视四周，视野渐渐清晰。

自己倒在一片湿漉漉的草地上，四周是高耸入云的乔木，树冠交织如绿色穹顶，遮天蔽日。

阳光从缝隙中洒下斑驳光影，照亮了地面上厚厚的落叶和藤蔓，空气中弥漫着青草与泥土的潮腥味。

力气恢复，似乎知觉也更清晰了些，湿热的气息扑面而来，草叶的刺挠感更明显了。

“这是…雨林？”

王言瞳孔微缩，有些不可思议。

但很快，他便自己说服了自己：“没事，没事，咱们这种天天看小说的，穿越很正常。”

王言宁愿相信自己穿越了，也不相信在中国，会有人能悄无声息的绑架自己，然后将自己送到一个雨林里就不管了。

“穿越了该怎么办？”

接受了现实，王言先问了自己一个问题。

然后他自己回答了自己：“首先，最重要的，不要慌，慌张是负面情绪，没有任何作用，其次要恢复体力，然后确认周围环境，寻找是否有人为痕迹…”

人是群居动物，或许有大神能荒野独居，也过得很好，但王言有自知之明，身为新一代的社会主义巨婴，玩两天的荒野求生，自己或许可以凭借身上的脂肪做到，但长久的在荒野中独居，那就是自杀。

找到人，确认是否可以交流，然后加入集体，才是自己活下去的希望。

确认目标方案。

王言找了个舒服的坐姿，坐在原地休息起来。

休息的时候，王言也在规划接下来的行动。

“先确认方向，按照植被的特性，树木枝叶多向南侧更茂盛，不对，不一定是向南，但肯定是向阳面。”

王言不确定自己还在不在现代，也不确定自己还在不在地球上，更不确定这里的太阳是不是东升西落。

但自己还能呼吸，这里有氧气，那么，植物应该也还遵循向阳的规律。

至少能确认一个方向了。

“其次，如果这里的生命也是碳基生命的话…那么，他们就需要喝水，我应该优先寻找河流，顺流而下。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

A hint of grassy smell came from the tip of his nose. Wang Yan felt that he had regained a little sense of touch, and there was also a tingling feeling of grass blades under his body.

I opened my eyes subconsciously, my eyelids were a little heavy, and I felt weak all over.

‘What’s wrong with me?’

Gradually, the thoughts in my mind began to come alive again.

Soon, Wang Yan remembered the last scene before he fell into coma.

"By the way, while I was doing my daily work, I was discussing with people on a DND post what kind of spells there are. They are very powerful in the setting, but they are not very outstanding in the game..."

His brain gradually became clearer, and Wang Yan's strength seemed to have recovered some. He looked around with difficulty, and his vision gradually became clearer.

He fell on a piece of wet grass, surrounded by towering trees, whose crowns intertwined like green domes, blocking out the sky and the sun.

The sun casts dappled light and shadow from the gaps, illuminating the thick fallen leaves and vines on the ground, and the air is filled with the damp smell of grass and soil.

His strength was restored, and his consciousness seemed to be clearer. The hot and humid breath hit his face, and the tingling sensation of the grass blades became more obvious.

"This is...a rainforest?"

Wang Yan's pupils shrank, a little unbelievable.

But soon, he convinced himself: "It's okay, it's okay. For those of us who read novels every day, time travel is normal."

Wang Yan would rather believe that he has traveled through time than believe that someone in China can kidnap him quietly, then send him to a rain forest and leave him alone.

"What should I do if I travel through time?"

After accepting the reality, Wang Yan asked himself a question first.

Then he answered himself: "First of all, the most important thing is, don't panic. Panic is a negative emotion and has no effect. Secondly, you need to recover your physical strength, and then confirm the surrounding environment and look for any human traces..."

Humans are social animals, and there may be great people who can live alone in the wilderness and live well, but Wang Yan is self-aware. As a new generation of socialist giants, he may be able to survive in the wilderness for two days with the help of his body fat, but living alone in the wilderness for a long time is suicide.

Finding someone, confirming whether you can communicate, and then joining the group is your hope for survival.

Confirm target plan.

Wang Yan found a comfortable sitting position and sat down to rest.

While resting, Wang Yan was also planning his next action.

"Confirm the direction first. According to the characteristics of vegetation, the branches and leaves of trees are more lush toward the south. No, it is not necessarily south, but it must be the sunny side."

Wang Yan is not sure whether he is still in modern times, nor is he sure whether he is still on the earth, nor is he sure whether the sun here rises in the east and sets in the west.

But I can still breathe, and there is oxygen here, so the plants should still follow the law of facing the sun.

At least one direction can be confirmed.

"Secondly, if the life here is also carbon-based life...then they need to drink water, and I should prioritize finding rivers and going down the river."
